Indonesia Rescues and Releases Endangered Wildlife

Indonesian authorities have rescued and released endangered animals on separate occasions. In one instance, 20 green sea turtles were released into the ocean after a smuggling attempt in Bali was foiled. In another operation, eight orangutans, rescued from wildfires, were released into a protected forest.
